title: Investigating stability on a flying-wing QuadPlane
intro: Configuration review, vibration analysis and flight-trial support for a 4+1 VTOL aircraft.
sections: This engagement began with an unstable flying-wing QuadPlane. I rebuilt and reviewed the Pixhawk 6C and ArduPlane setup, including motor and servo assignments, calibration and QuadPlane settings.
Read the response, not just the settings

I reviewed attitude tracking, IMU clipping, vibration and FFT data to connect the reported behaviour with the recorded response. That analysis informed configuration corrections and PID-tuning support.
Close the loop with the client

The delivery combined a technical report, troubleshooting guidance and remote support for successful client flight trials. The work covered configuration and diagnostics; the client carried out the physical tests.

title: From helicopter logs to the next test plan
intro: Reviewing configuration, vibration and estimator behaviour without overstating the validation reached.
sections: The supplied logs raised questions around position drift, altitude and yaw tracking. I reviewed swashplate and servo mapping, governor and RPM behaviour, motor interlock, failsafes, yaw response and power-bus data.

The diagnostic work also covered vibration and notch filtering, external INS and EKF3 configuration, and rangefinder settings. Each finding needed to connect a recorded symptom with a check or corrective recommendation.

The latest supplied evidence supported a static run-up review and recommendations for further hover testing. I documented findings and acceptance criteria for subsequent tests. This is not a claim of a completed post-fix flight campaign.

title: Turning a fixed-wing concept into a workshop package
intro: Organizing airframe geometry, interfaces and fabrication information so that a concept can progress toward a build.
sections: The study developed a modular twin-tractor fixed-wing concept using accessible foam structures and tube reinforcement. I prepared parametric geometry, mechanical interfaces and assembly information around that approach.

The package included foam-cutting templates, CNC part information, tube-stock planning, assembly views, part lists and printable workshop guides. The aim was to connect the CAD model to an understandable build sequence.

The delivered checks were CAD and preparation checks. Physical structural validation, final equipment fits and flight testing remain separate activities. No manufactured aircraft or flight result is implied by the documentation package.
